purpose: Bind all project-specific work to a HUMAN-owned remote Git repository or local Git workspace while keeping SAFOR product/package sources out of project storage.

REMOTE_GIT.projectArtifactRule: All Factory-produced domain artifacts remain in the selected HUMAN project repository.

LOCAL_GIT.projectArtifactRule: All Factory-produced domain artifacts remain under the HUMAN-selected local Git workspace.

hardRules: Canonical SAFOR repository cannot be the project workspace.
Commercial package source cannot be the project workspace.
Project workspace binding is explicit HUMAN-controlled context.
Local mutating execution requires a valid Git repository.
Project workspace and package entitlement are independent.
